description:
Start a real Agent Conversion audit: an autonomous browsing agent opens the given website and tries to complete the task, then the run is scored 0-100 with problems and recommendations.

Use this when someone wants to know whether an AI agent can find something or complete a commercial step on a specific website, e.g. "Can an agent find the Pro plan's monthly price on example.com?" or "Can an agent start the self-service signup on example.com?".

Returns immediately with an audit_id and status "pending" — it does NOT wait for the result. Call get_conversion_report with the audit_id to get the result.

Rules: url must be a public http(s) URL (no localhost, private IPs, credentials or custom ports). task must be 10-1000 characters and describe the goal in plain language; phrase purchase-like goals as "reach checkout without buying". Each call costs a real browser run and is rate limited: do not call it repeatedly for the same url+task — poll get_conversion_report instead. Error codes rate_limited, daily_limit and at_capacity mean try again later.

locale.description: Language for the generated summary and recommendations: "en" (default) or "es".

task.description: The commercial task in plain language, e.g. "Find the monthly price of the Pro plan" or "Start the free trial signup and stop before entering payment details".

url.description: Public website URL to test, including https://, e.g. https://www.example.com or https://www.example.com/pricing.

name: test_conversion

report_url.description: Human-readable report; available once the audit completes (404 before).

title: Test agent conversion on a website
